design_notes.verify_release_prep_098_status_design: DESIGN CHOICE (recorded per the plan's explicit instruction to choose and record): .agent/evidence/098/verify_release_prep.py's feature-completeness check is SCOPED TO 092-097 (six siblings, strictly required complete) PLUS an explicit, separate, non-failing acknowledgment line for feature 098's own status -- NOT a literal 'all seven complete' assertion. Rationale: this script is written and first run as CONTRACT VERIFICATION EVIDENCE during Loop 2 (validator Mode B / evaluator QA), which happens BEFORE the generator's Step 7 durable-state procedure flips feature 098's own status to complete in .agent/feature_list_013.json (per protocol 07B Step 7 and this run's own established precedent -- e.g. the 2026-08-19T10:04:37Z run_state history event: 'Feature-lifecycle surfaces (feature_list_013, phase_013.yaml) were correctly left untouched by the generator' during implementation). A literal 'all(status==complete for all 7)' assertion, mirrored verbatim from .agent/evidence/091/verify_release_prep.py's phase-012 precedent, would therefore FALSELY FAIL on every evidence-capture run this contract's own verification performs, before ever reaching the generator's own Step 7 -- a self-defeating design, since the contract's verification commands (see below) are exactly what proves the implementation ready for that flip. The script instead: (a) asserts `all(f['status']=='complete' for f in features if f['id'] != '098')` -- strict, six-of-six; (b) reads feature 098's own status and prints `PASS feature 098 status acknowledged ({status}) -- pre-Step-7 evidence capture expects non-complete; a post-Step-7 re-run legitimately observes 'complete'` as an explicit non-failing PASS line rather than silently skipping the id or crashing on a KeyError; (c) does NOT hard-require 098's own status to equal any particular value, so the identical script also runs cleanly, with the same acknowledgment line now trivially satisfied, when re-run after Step 7 flips it -- era-safe across the one status transition this script's own subject undergoes during its own feature's lifecycle, mirroring C16's if-present/non-crashing doctrine at a much smaller scale. The literal 'all seven complete' assertion required by feature_list_013.json's own acceptance_tests[3] (verbatim, verification item 4 below) is DELIBERATELY NOT relaxed -- it is a separate, correctly strict, contract-verification-list command run as the FINAL gate immediately before evidence capture completes, after the generator's Step 7 flip, exactly as the 091 precedent's identical-shaped check was run only once phase 012's own last feature had already landed.
